Use the pause to close gaps before certification restarts.
vertical_angles.Nonprofit: Enterprise-grade IT and security on a nonprofit budget; predictable monthly cost; board-ready reporting.
vertical_angles.Healthcare: HIPAA-aligned security, reliable uptime for clinical systems, and a local team that answers the phone.
vertical_angles.Religious: Reliable networks, AV/streaming, phones and security for multi-building campuses, with a budget-friendly flat rate.
vertical_angles.Government: Ohio HB 96 (ORC 9.64) now requires every city, village and township to adopt a cybersecurity program (cities by Jan 1 2026, townships and villages by July 1 2026), and the State Auditor is adding it to audits. infinIT can build, document and run the program, plus training and incident response.
vertical_angles.Government (co-managed): HB 96 cyber program requirements plus after-hours coverage, security depth and project help for your internal IT staff, without adding headcount.
